name: ElGreco
kurzbeschreibung:
**Welcome to ElGreco in Garmisch-Partenkirchen**

Discover the vibrant flavors of Greece in the heart of the Alps! At **ElGreco**, we bring you authentic Greek cuisine with a touch of Bavarian charm. Indulge in mouthwatering dishes like **Moussaka**, **Souvlaki**, and **Spanakopita**, paired with refreshing **Ouzo** or crisp **Retsina** wines.

Our cozy restaurant invites you to savor traditional Greek specialties in a warm, inviting atmosphere. Whether you're craving a hearty meal after a day of skiing in **Tirol** or a relaxed dinner with friends, **ElGreco** offers a taste of the Mediterranean just steps away from the stunning landscapes of **Garmisch-Partenkirchen**.

Come experience the perfect blend of Alpine adventure and Greek hospitality—only at **ElGreco**!
